description_en: Queries the region to which the public IP address of the asset within the current Alibaba Cloud account belongs. The asset can be an elastic IP address (EIP). The asset can also be an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance or Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance that is assigned a public IP address
